description: Canonical data rendering of the Fuaran UI wire vocabulary — kinds, unions, enums, records, field defaults and the node envelope. This is the STRUCTURAL source: it states what the vocabulary is, including optionality classes and omit-at-default values that a JSON Schema cannot express. schema.json beside it is the VALIDATION surface, derived from the same contract. Keys marked hostSurface are host-language declarations, not wire spec, and carry nothing observable on the wire. See WIRE_FORMAT.md section 13.
